summary: Builds an unbiased recall eval set for ANY repo from that machine's Claude Code transcripts plus the repo's notebook: parses ~/.claude/projects/<repo path with every non-alphanumeric → '-'> (override/add worktree dirs with --transcripts a,b) into turns, records compact_boundary timestamps per session, takes every human-typed prompt since the first note's .raw creation time, dedupes by session+text, and draws a uniform seeded sample (default 150, seed 20261109) — no retriever picks or shortlists anything. Freezes the notebook by rendering each note from .raw via this checkout's src/kb (loadAll + renderNote, no dist build) rather than copying notes/*.md, so a stale derived dir can't leak in. Writes work/items.json (5 prior exchanges, exclude = notes created after the prompt, writtenThisSession with compactedSince), catalog.md, packets of 20 and an empty labels.jsonl; refuses to overwrite items.json unless REBUILD=1 because that would change the sample under existing labels. Tool-command paths containing '..' are dropped from 'files in context' (they were git ranges like origin/main..HEAD).
